verdict.rationale: Make documents a first-party Make AI Agents app for agentic automation, and API endpoints to create and run AI Agents, currently in open beta. This is an in-product agent capability, but the evidence never shows a built-in assistant that a user can directly hand tasks to. The MCP server and Make Skills serve external assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant or copilot that accepts delegated tasks, details of how delegation works in the UI, general availability beyond open beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
